do_not_put_in_packet: Invented outcomes or guessed resolution dates.
Live lookup results that were not saved as local evidence.
Secrets, cookies, wallet material, or authenticated data.

paper_hypothesis_result_labels.aligned: Approved local outcome review found the paper hypothesis directionally aligned with the result.
paper_hypothesis_result_labels.ambiguous: Approved local outcome review found the result cannot fairly score the paper hypothesis.
paper_hypothesis_result_labels.not_aligned: Approved local outcome review found the paper hypothesis did not align with the result.
paper_hypothesis_result_labels.pending: Outcome is unresolved and feedback is not ready.
paper_hypothesis_result_labels.void: Approved local outcome review found the market was void or excluded from scoring.

purpose: Explain how an operator later completes a manual outcome packet for paper-only feedback.
safety_rules: No scheduler, daemon, background worker, or polling loop.

source_accuracy_feedback.contradicted: Source was contradicted by the approved local outcome record.
source_accuracy_feedback.insufficient: Source did not provide enough resolution evidence.
source_accuracy_feedback.misleading: Source framing led analysis away from the approved local outcome record.
source_accuracy_feedback.pending: Outcome unresolved; no source accuracy claim.
source_accuracy_feedback.unknown: Local packet does not support a source accuracy claim.
source_accuracy_feedback.useful: Source helped the approved local outcome review.
